aarti.tek: Victory to you, Lakṣmī and Viṣṇu;
victory to you, Lakṣmī and Viṣṇu.
Victory to you, Mādhava; victory to you, lord of Śrī.
Victory, victory, victory to you, Viṣṇu.
aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Lakṣmī, coloured like the champak flower;
victory to you, Viṣṇu, whose lustre is that of a rain cloud.
Victory to you, Lakṣmī, graced by a gentle smile;
victory to you, Viṣṇu, of wondrous peace.
aarti.pad2: Lakṣmī, holding a lotus, your hands granting boons and freedom from fear;
Viṣṇu, bearer of the conch and the rest:
victory to you, Lakṣmī, who dwell in the lotus,
and Viṣṇu, who ride Garuḍa as your seat.
aarti.pad3: Lakṣmī, whose hands and feet are of being and consciousness;
Viṣṇu, whose form is being and consciousness;
Lakṣmī, who delight in divine bliss:
victory to you, Viṣṇu, whose form is bliss.
aarti.pad4: You are the mother of the three worlds;
you are the protector of all.
You are the mother who gave birth to the three worlds;
you are the upholder of all.
aarti.pad5: You are the giver of wealth, kin, happiness,
and you, who wear the garland of forest flowers, are the giver of supreme bliss.
aarti.pad6: You dwell in homes where there is good sense;
you are the master of all,
the indweller of the sentient and the insentient.
aarti.pad7: I have come to you for refuge;
Victory to you, Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa, giver of ever-new blessings.
